subject: Forecast Sonar: pre-commit hygiene & churn probes
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Julie Park <julie@brightbyte.io>
Date: 2027-10-25T16:12:00Z
Subject: Forecast Sonar: pre-commit hygiene & churn probes

Team / Julie —

Kicking off a quick "Forecast Sonar" thread for BrightByte (BB-2027-RENEW-43). Finance asked us to revalidate the commit and surface any churn signals before the Nov renewal cadence. High-level notes:

- Current ARR on renewal: $420k; listed probability in the forecast is 80%.
- Usage dipped ~28% MoM across two product lines in September; internal telemetry attached (bb_usage_snapshot_q3.csv).
- BrightByte has an open POC for a competing vendor (they mentioned evaluation in Sept).

Asks:
1) Julie — can you confirm whether the evaluation is active and if procurement timeline has shifted? Any PO intent or internal approvals we should expect?
2) Naomi / Marissa — please flag any billing or entitlements issues that could impact committed ARR (seat drops, paused connectors, credits). If we need to adjust probability or stage, call it out.
3) I'll propose a quick 15-min sync next week if we need to triage.

Attachments: bb_usage_snapshot_q3.csv (summary export). HubSpot link below for deal notes.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

----
Attachment: bb_usage_snapshot_q3.csv (CSV, 42 KB)

From: Julie Park <julie@brightbyte.io>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2027-10-27T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Forecast Sonar: pre-commit hygiene & churn probes

Thanks for the heads up, Dylan.

Quick update from our side: the evaluation with Vendor X is still exploratory — they ran a small throughput test but there hasn't been an internal buy decision. Usage dip was driven by an internal data pipeline migration that paused a subset of automated jobs for ~3 weeks in September; that was the bulk of the drop.

Procurement timeline: finance is doing an end-of-month review the week of Nov 8th. I can share a short renewal intent note (attached) and confirm whether they want to push to Q4 purchasing or keep it on the Nov runway.

I attached a 1-pager (renewal_intent.pdf) with our current internal signals. Happy to hop on a short triage if it helps.

—Julie
Julie Park
Head of Platform, BrightByte

----
Attachment: renewal_intent.pdf (PDF, 18 KB)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-29T09:32:00Z
Subject: Re: Forecast Sonar: pre-commit hygiene & churn probes

Fyi — I pulled billing + contract history for BB-2027-RENEW-43. Key items:

- Two entitlements (Connector A, Connector B) show reduced usage; invoiced seats unchanged but usage below threshold for a usage-based discount.
- Last invoice (Aug) was paid on time; no disputes on file.
- They used a one-time migration credit tied to Q2 onboarding that reduces ARR by $12k on renewal if not renewed at full term.

Risk assessment (preliminary): 60% probability for base renewal at current list; 30% probability of partial renewal (drop Connector B or reduce seats); 10% churn. Recommend we drop probability from 80 -> 60 in the Nov forecast until Julie confirms procurement timing.

Action items:
- Dylan: capture any concession ask (credits / pricing) if BrightByte seeks to stay.
- Marissa: can you update HubSpot and tag deal with "usage-dip" + "migration-paused"?

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Finance — Renewals Operations

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Julie Park <julie@brightbyte.io>
Date: 2027-11-01T17:21:00Z
Subject: Re: Forecast Sonar: pre-commit hygiene & churn probes

Thanks Naomi — that aligns with what I've been seeing. Julie, based on finance input I wanted to propose two quick measures to keep the renewal on the Nov runway:

1) Schedule a 15-min ops call w/ BrightByte + Redwood solutions to confirm the migration window and identify quick wins to stabilize usage (we can offer a free connector health-check).
2) Offer a one-time holdback credit of up to $10k contingent on a signed renewal by Nov 20th; this is smaller than their migration credit but helps bridge procurement approvals.

If Julie can confirm procurement review date, I'll book the ops call. Marissa — if you agree, please prepare a HubSpot note with the proposed concession and tag the deal as a "conditional credit".

Quoted for context:
> On 2027-10-29 Naomi Feldman wrote:
> > Recommend we drop probability from 80 -> 60 in the Nov forecast until Julie confirms procurement timing.

Link to deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/BB-2027-RENEW-43

Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-03T22:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Forecast Sonar: pre-commit hygiene & churn probes

All done — updated the forecast and the deal notes:

- Probability adjusted to 60% for renewal ARR line item; added a secondary row for "partial renewal" $120k at 30% probability.
- HubSpot tags added: usage-dip, migration-paused, conditional-credit-10k.
- Set task: follow up with Julie on Nov 9th post procurement review; assigned to Dylan.

Marissa
